contexts.abstract: Teams speech experiences are converging onto a unified multilingual stack.
contexts.text: Teams speech experiences (Interpreter, Captions/Transcription) are being converged onto a unified, multilingual stack with stronger entity accuracy and reliability.

contexts.abstract: Turn‑by‑Turn Interpreter is introduced to fix SIM accuracy and flow gaps.
contexts.text: Turn‑by‑Turn (TBT) Interpreter is being introduced to solve accuracy and meeting flow gaps in interactive and structured meetings, reducing translation overlap and clarifying who is speaking.

contexts.abstract: Multilingual STT has shipped to R0/R1 with auto language detection.
contexts.text: Multilingual STT has shipped to Ring 0 and Ring 1 with a unified multi‑recognizer endpoint and automatic language detection, eliminating setup friction and enabling bilingual meetings.

contexts.abstract: Transcript Enricher is correcting high‑value meetings at scale.
contexts.text: Transcript Enricher is correcting names and domain entities in high‑value meetings at scale, with R4 rollout at 50% for EN/JP and 10% for FR/DE/PT/ES and 1.8M+ meetings weekly enhanced.

contexts.abstract: Batch S2S display models improved readability across Tier‑1 locales.
contexts.text: Batch speech‑to‑speech (S2S) display models have raised transcript readability across Tier‑1 locales without increasing cost of goods sold (CoGS).

contexts.abstract: Customers see accuracy issues on technical terms, names, and numbers.
contexts.text: Customers report accuracy issues on technical terms, names, and numbers/units, and perceive translations as too literal in simultaneous mode.
contexts.resolution_hint: Invest in entity enrichment, global/custom dictionaries, and semantic translation modes.

contexts.abstract: Latency and flow issues in SIM affect meeting experience.
contexts.text: Latency and meeting flow in simultaneous interpretation, especially alignment with shared content and sensitivity to first‑sentence delay, are key customer pain points.
contexts.resolution_hint: Use TTS acceleration, audio prefix, segmentation improvements, and TBT mode to mitigate perceived latency.

contexts.abstract: Tone and gender/voice mismatches in JP/KR raise RAI concerns.
contexts.text: Tone and naturalness issues in Japanese and Korean, along with occasional gender/voice mismatches where voice simulation is off, create user dissatisfaction and Responsible AI risks.
contexts.resolution_hint: Improve tone control and voice selection for JP/KR and add guardrails against misgendering and harassment.

contexts.abstract: SIM semantic mode and TTS acceleration improve quality and latency.
contexts.text: Simultaneous Interpreter (SIM) has semantic mode enabled in lower rings and TTS acceleration (1.2×–1.35×) to reduce accumulated translated audio latency, with reliability around 99%+.

contexts.abstract: TBT R0 is available with strong JP/KR feedback but 25‑session limit.
contexts.text: Turn‑by‑Turn Interpreter Ring 0 is available; early Japanese and Korean customer and GBB feedback shows strong accuracy and clearer turn‑taking, with known limits including 25 concurrent sessions and edge‑case behaviors under complex turns.

contexts.abstract: SIM latency mitigations include speedup mode and audio prefix.
contexts.text: Latency and UX enhancements for SIM include speedup mode, an audio prefix before the first translation to mask round‑trip time, and auto‑update spoken language detection via multilingual STT.

contexts.abstract: Transcription++ elevates transcription into an enterprise understanding layer.
contexts.text: Transcription++ aims to elevate transcription into an enterprise understanding layer with a tiered model stack, stronger grounding and enrichment (global and custom dictionaries, dynamic vocabulary), governance‑by‑design, and multilingual by default.

contexts.abstract: Real‑time quality layer focuses on entity enrichment and latency mitigation.
contexts.text: A real‑time quality enhancement layer is being built around entity enrichment, latency mitigation (audio prefix, segmentation improvements), and a biasing/adaptation framework using global and custom dictionaries across languages.

contexts.abstract: Admin Center reporting and metering enable governance and value articulation.
contexts.text: Admin Center usage reporting (CFR) and metering integration are underway to provide visibility into tenant adoption, meeting types, and language pairs, laying the foundation for enterprise governance and value articulation.

contexts.abstract: Unified evaluation uses LLM‑as‑judge for end‑to‑end quality metrics.
contexts.text: Unified evaluation now uses LLM‑as‑judge metrics for transcription and interpreter, producing consistent semantic, tone, latency, and entity scores across models and enabling apples‑to‑apples comparisons and faster iteration.

contexts.abstract: Multi‑recognizer platform enables hot‑switching between model families.
contexts.text: A multi‑recognizer platform coming January 2026 for Teams will allow hot‑switching between STS and LRM/LLM‑based models, simplifying pipelines and enabling faster experimentation with Phi‑4, multimodal LLMs, and unified multilingual models.

contexts.abstract: GPU capacity and LLM onboarding timelines are key risks.
contexts.text: GPU capacity and substrate LLM onboarding timelines for real‑time models pose risks, requiring maintained fallback paths with compliance controls.
contexts.resolution_hint: Secure GPU allocations, stage LLM onboarding, and harden fallback paths with compliance guardrails.

contexts.abstract: Admin reporting data ownership and latency need alignment.
contexts.text: Admin reporting CFR data cooking ownership and data latency require alignment between IDEAs and PM on contracts, creating a governance and accountability gap.
contexts.resolution_hint: Clarify ownership, SLAs, and contracts for CFR data pipelines between engineering and PM.

contexts.abstract: Responsible AI risks include harassment and misgendering.
contexts.text: Responsible AI risks include harassment and misgendering due to tone and gender defaults in speech translation models, particularly in JP/KR, requiring guardrails and tone control improvements.
contexts.resolution_hint: Implement RAI guardrails, monitoring, and tone control features for sensitive locales.

contexts.abstract: North star is >80% CSAT for interpreter with SIM and TBT modes.
contexts.text: The north star is to achieve over 80% CSAT for interpreter experiences by using SIM for fluid conversations, TBT for structured discussions, and eventually automatic mode switching based on meeting context.

content.headline: Teams Speech & Interpreter: Trust & Scale Plan
content.subtitle: Unifying multilingual stack and expanding Turn-by-Turn (TBT) mode

slides.story: Situation: Establish current momentum and adoption metrics
slides.visual_design: KPI grid with four metric cards and a highlighted amber warning box for the primary blocker.

content.headline: Adoption is rising on 99%+ reliability
content.subtitle: Momentum is real; the constraint is trust in accuracy and tone.
content.speaker_intent: Show the audience that while reliability is solved, trust is the next frontier.

bullets.text: 136k MAU
62.2% >5-min Meeting Rate
99.38% E2E Reliability
71% Customer Sat
Trust in accuracy/tone is the primary blocker for enterprise scale.

slides.story: Complication: Identify specific pain points preventing expansion and the proposed solutions
slides.visual_design: Two-column layout: left = gaps/pain points; right = strategic pillars/solution. Optional 1-line connector in the middle: 'So we…'.

content.headline: Close the quality gaps to unlock enterprise scale
content.subtitle: What’s stalling expansion—and the 3-pillar plan to fix it

bullets.text: Entity errors: names and technical terms are often “almost right.”
Flow/latency: first-turn delays degrade meeting rhythm.
Market gaps: tone/naturalness issues in JP/KR.
Admin blockers: incomplete reporting + licensing confusion.
Unified platform: converge Interpreter + Captions/Transcription on one multilingual stack with shared endpoints and schemas.
Adaptive modes: SIM for fluid conversations; TBT for structured, high-stakes meetings to improve flow and clarity.
Quality layer: improve entity correctness with global/custom dictionaries + Enricher at scale.
Enterprise controls: admin reporting, metering, and rollout quality gates to enable governance and confident expansion.

slides.story: Situation: Validating current progress with existing building blocks
slides.visual_design: Four-card grid highlighting technical achievements like Multilingual STT and Enricher Scaling.

content.headline: Key building blocks are already in market

bullets.text: Multilingual STT: 9 languages in preview; R0/R1 completed. Unified endpoint live.
Enricher Scaling: 1.8M+ meetings enhanced weekly. 50% EN/JP coverage reached.
TBT Readiness: Early feedback from JP/KR positive. Capacity at 25 concurrent sessions.
TTS Speedup: 1.2x–1.35x gains shipped; audio prefix enabled to minimize latency.

slides.story: Answer: Prove the effectiveness of the Enricher tool with data
slides.visual_design: Comparison with baseline vs. post-enricher metrics and a highlighted 'Improvement'

bullets.text: Post-meeting Enricher impact: transcription inaccuracy reduced 19.5% → 12.3% (↓37%) → direct lift in transcript trust where it matters.
Domain entity errors ↓34% and accent/dialect issues ↓31% → targets the most common “high-stakes meeting” failure modes.
Corresponding CSAT increased 42.95% → 62.32% (reported) → quality fixes translate into user satisfaction, not just model scores.
Batch S2S display model upgrades improve readability without increasing CoGS → scalable quality lift across traffic.

slides.story: Answer: Explain the value proposition of Turn-by-Turn (TBT) mode
slides.visual_design: Use a visual to reinforce the main message

content.headline: TBT is the accuracy-and-flow escape hatch

bullets.text: TBT (R0 available) improves turn clarity and reduces overlap → directly targets SIM’s interactive-meeting breakdowns.
Early JP/KR customer/GBB feedback shows strong accuracy and clearer turn-taking → prioritizes markets with known tone/quality gaps.
Known current limit: 25 concurrent sessions with edge-case behaviors under complex turns → scaling and hardening are the next constraints.

slides.story: Answer: Explain the risk mitigation strategy via Quality Gates
slides.visual_design: Vertical flow-step layout with numbered circles and descriptive text blocks.

bullets.text: LLM-as-judge metrics： Automated semantic consistency checks and tone accuracy verification. Real-time entity error detection before tenant deployment.
Live Performance Telemetry： Instrumentation focus on "First Sentence Latency" and "Segmentation Success Rate." We stop rollouts if rhythm degradation is detected.
R0/R1 Ring Discipline: Mandatory validation cycles in internal and dogfood rings. Ensures zero reliability regressions for global tenants during H2 expansion.

slides.story: Answer: Detail the administrative and governance strategy
slides.visual_design: a simple three-step flow visual that summarizes the admin deliverables as sequential building blocks leading to deployable governance.

bullets.text: Admin Center Usage Dashboard (Public Preview — Mar 31, 2026): Tenant adoption tracking live; includes meeting types and language pairs by plan
Metering (in progress): Complete integration and validate data to enable usage reporting, governance, and value measurement
Licensing clarity (priority): Resolution of guest access blockers (cross-tenant/guest) to prevent rollout delays

slides.story: Answer: Visualize the timeline for upcoming releases and goals
slides.visual_design: Horizontal timeline with three milestones (Near, Future, North Star) connected by a central axis line.

content.headline: Strategic Roadmap: From Stabilization to Scale

bullets.text: TBT Expansion: Concurrency scale to 100 sessions.
Multilingual GA: Stable 9-language unified stack.
R1 Completion: Cross-region failover testing.
Admin Preview: Speech Governance Dashboard live.
Entity Safety: Auto-Dictionary for tenant terms.
Mobile Support: Full TBT parity on iOS/Android.
85% Satisfaction: Target for JP/KR premium markets.
Zero Latency: Predictive prefix buffering GA.
Trust at Scale: 1M+ weekly secured meetings.

slides.story: ending: Summary of risks and final decision request
slides.visual_design: Standard data table for risks/mitigation followed by a bold 'Action Required' footer box.

content.headline: LT decisions: capacity, governance, and safety
content.subtitle: Decisions to unblock scale, governance, and quality commitments
content.speaker_intent: Get LT alignment on the few cross-org decisions that determine whether we can scale TBT/SIM quality, meet enterprise governance needs, and manage risk.

bullets.text: Approve/confirm GPU capacity plan for real-time models and the substrate LLM onboarding timeline; align on required fallback paths + compliance controls.
Confirm multi-environment scale direction (e.g., expanding from ~10 → 20 environments) and associated infra priority.
Agree on SPOF/error-handling maturity bar and incident monitoring ownership/alignment across rings and environments (including retry/controller strategy for Voice Live API).
Assign a single DRI for Admin reporting CFR “data cooking” and data-latency SLAs; align IDEAs + PM on contracts/definitions.
Confirm metering validation expectations and what must be ready for Admin Center usage dashboard public preview (target Mar 31, 2026).
Approve RAI guardrails and launch criteria for harassment/misgendering risk mitigation, including JP/KR tone-control quality bar.
Decision on recording parity for interpreted audio (e.g., multi-track options) to unlock recap/compliance scenarios—confirm scope and priority.
